items.title: Island notification tint & ticker
steps: Receive a notification: notice the island popup background subtly matches the app's icon color palette.
Enable 'Rolling notification ticker' to see long notification messages roll smoothly across the pill rather than expanding into a card.

items.title: Island flashlight pill indicator
steps: Turn on the flashlight from Control Center or quick settings.
Notice the glowing amber Flashlight indicator in the Island; tap it to turn the flashlight off.

items.title: Widget placement blueprint preview
steps: Pick up or move a widget across Home grid cells.
Observe the glowing frosted blueprint outline and subtle scale response as it hovers over valid targets.

items.title: App shortcut menu palette tint
steps: Long press or swipe up on an app (e.g. Google Play Store): the context shortcut menu background adopts a frosted glass tint sampled from the app icon color.

items.title: Seamless unfolded two-page spacing
items.where: Foldables unfolded Home screen (Settings > Grid, icon size & dock)
steps: Unfold flat: notice the left and right pages sit closer together for a uniform layout.
Partly fold into book posture: notice the halves smoothly separate away from the hinge crease.

items.title: Nixie & Minimalist StandBy clocks
items.where: Settings > Fold & Displays > StandBy > Clock Style
steps: Select Nixie for warm orange vacuum filament numerals with glass tube reflections.
Select Minimal for hairline divider with clean date capsule and high-contrast numerals.

items.title: StandBy interactive widget stack
steps: Tap or swipe vertically on the widget card in StandBy to cycle between Up Next Calendar, Month Grid, and Device Vitals with animated dot indicator and directional transitions.

items.title: Page-edge resistance elasticity
steps: Swipe past the first Home page or past App Library: notice the smooth elastic resistance that pulls back smoothly rather than hitting a hard stop.

items.title: Expand widget temporarily preview
steps: Long press any built-in widget and select 'Expand temporarily': an interactive card opens with detailed info and app shortcuts without modifying the saved Home layout.

items.title: Duo status rail & charging bolt
steps: Plug in your device: notice the compact charging bolt indicator beside the battery percentage/ring and the gentle pulse response.
Observe tabular numerals keeping the clock and reading steady as minutes advance.

items.title: Control Center toggles & sheets
steps: Open Control Center: toggle Battery Saver, Flashlight, and Rotation Lock; observe active state accents.
Tap Wi-Fi or Bluetooth: observe the quick system panel sheet without leaving the launcher.

items.title: Dual-screen ambient lamp
items.where: Settings > Fold & Displays > StandBy > Dual-Screen Ambient Light
steps: Enable Dual-Screen Ambient Light, prop phone in tent or bedside posture with StandBy active.
The outer cover screen softly illuminates as a warm bedside night lamp.

items.title: Notification Center preview pane
items.where: Notification Center on wide screens (>= 700 dp, such as unfolded Fold)
steps: Unfold the phone and pull down Notification Center.
Notifications appear in a list on the left with full preview and actions on the right.
Tap a notification to select it and preview full body, inline replies, and action buttons.

items.title: StandBy clock styles
steps: Try Split-Flap, Neon Glow, Analog, and Solar Arc clock styles.
Verify rolling digit transitions and dial animations.
Preview in Settings should scale cleanly without cutting off.

items.title: StandBy interactive widgets
steps: Tap the widget card in StandBy to cycle between Up Next Calendar and Device Vitals.
Verify the vertical 3-dot stack indicator updates.

items.title: StandBy notifications
steps: Choose Colors or Count Only under Notifications in StandBy.
Send a notification: the screen edge should glow softly in the app's accent color.
Verify unread dots appear with the app count.

items.title: Dual-screen ambient glow
steps: Place your Fold in tent mode or slightly open with StandBy on.
The secondary screen should illuminate with a steady ambient glow matching your clock color.

items.title: Swipe to Google Discover
steps: Swipe left to Google Discover with an Android system wallpaper set.
No drawn Dunes background should flash or appear behind the feed.

items.title: Control Center pages and swipe away
items.where: Home, status rail. Fold: try the cover and the inner screen
steps: Tap the status rail on Home to open Control Center. Swipe down from a gap between tiles: the next page should follow your finger and settle, and a short drag should spring back. If the strip shows only one page, go to step 3.
Swipe up on that page: it should go back to the page before, without closing the panel.
On the first page, drag up from empty space: the panel should follow your finger, tick lightly at the point where letting go closes it, and close on release. A short slow drag should spring back.
Tap the close button beside power: it should close. Open it again and tap the empty margin around the grid: it should close. Tap between two tiles: it should stay open.

items.title: Status rail tap and hold
steps: Tap the status capsule: Control Center should open.
Hold the capsule for a couple of seconds: only the capsule should shade, with no faint second pill above it.
Enter Edit Home and tap the capsule: Control Center should not open.

items.title: Sliders follow the volume keys
items.where: Control Center. Play something in a music app first
steps: Open Control Center and press the volume keys: the volume slider should move with each press, within about a quarter of a second.
Mute the music volume with the keys: the slider should read empty.

items.title: Open folders blur Home behind them
items.where: Home and App Library. Fold: cover and inner screen
steps: Open a folder on Home: Home should blur and dim behind it as it opens, and none of Home's clock or date text should show behind the folder's title.
Open a category folder in the App Library: the same blur and dim.
Close it: Home should be sharp again. With Reduce Transparency on (Settings > Accessibility, switch it back after) there should be no blur, a darker dim and a solid card.

items.title: Landscape Home keeps every row
items.where: Home app, rotation. Turn auto-rotate on for this, then set it back. Fold: cover and inner
steps: Rotate the phone to landscape on Home: every row of apps should be whole, with labels, above the Search strip. A short window should split into two columns.
Turn from landscape to portrait and back a few times, and fold and unfold with Home open: Folio should not close.

items.title: A turned-off app keeps its spot
items.where: Android Settings > Apps. Turn the app back on afterwards
steps: Pick an app that is on Home or in the dock and that Android lets you Turn off (a preinstalled app). Tap Turn off, then go to Home: its icon should stay in the same spot, dimmed.
Turn the app on again: the icon should be back at full strength in the same spot, with no hole left in the grid.

items.title: Large text is not cut off
items.where: Android Settings > Display > Font size. Set the size back afterwards
steps: Set the font to its largest size. On Home, app labels should grow but stay whole, and the clock and date cards should fit.
Open Spotlight: the web search chips (Ask ChatGPT and the others) should wrap onto a second line, none cut off at the edge.
Open Folio's Settings and the Market: tab labels should stay whole, the back label should give way to Done, and the Market's Featured banner text should end with an ellipsis rather than being cut.

items.title: Settings stays put on a size change
items.where: Folio Settings, then Android Settings > Display. Set the size back afterwards
steps: Open Folio's Settings on Wallpaper & Appearance. Switch to Android's Settings, change Display size (Screen zoom on Samsung) one step, and switch back: Folio's Settings should still be on Wallpaper & Appearance.
Do the same in the Market on its Installed tab: it should stay there and not jump to Featured.

items.title: Pull down from any app
steps: Turn on Folio's panels over other apps, then Pull down from the top of any app (Android asks you to turn on Folio's gestures service).
Open another app and drag down from the top left: Notification Center should open over it. Drag down from the top right: Control Center.
Behind each panel there should be a blurred picture of that app. If there is only a flat color, turn Folio's gestures service off and on once in Android's Accessibility settings and try again.

items.title: Control Center look and size
steps: Under Control Center look, step through Clear glass, Frosted and Solid. Clear glass is the start; white text should stay readable over a bright wallpaper in all three, and Frosted should have no darker plate behind the tiles.
Step Control Center size from Small to Extra Large: nothing should scroll or be cut off. Hold a tile: it should dip. Drag the brightness slider: it should show its percent.

items.title: Smart clock ink
items.where: Settings > Wallpaper & Appearance > Text on Home. It uses a second accessibility service
steps: With Android's own wallpaper behind Home and a Big Clock on Home, turn on Smart clock ink. Android's Accessibility screen should open: turn on Folio Smart clock ink.
Go back to Home: the clock text should be light or dark to suit what is really behind the clock. Try a pale wallpaper and a dark one, and say if the text ever flips back and forth.
Turn the service off in Accessibility: the clock text should go back to following Android's wallpaper colors.

items.title: Setup: Your Home apps
items.where: First setup, from the button below
steps: Tap Open the New Setup below and pick a starting point. On the Your Home apps page, tick and untick apps: the grid above should change at once, with ticked apps packed in two rows. Apps that share a name should show their package name underneath.
Tap Skip: Home should stay as it was. Do not tap Use Folio now or Continue unless you have a layout backup, as they change your Home.

items.title: The Rows menu names Automatic
steps: Choose 6 rows, then open the menu again: Automatic should show the number it would give on this screen, not 6. Put Rows back to what you had.

items.title: Settings in three groups
steps: Open Settings: General and Accessibility should come first, then Launcher, then Extensions. Privacy & Permissions and Support Folio should be under General. Say if anything you used to find is now hard to find.

items.title: Widgets make room for apps
steps: Drag a widget onto a spot with apps, then resize one taller over a row of apps. The apps should move along instead of the spot turning red.
With a full page, the last apps should carry on to a new page. Then use Undo Last Layout Change: everything should return.
Watch that the apps slide into place smoothly, also with Reduce Motion on.
